name: A List of Important Maximum Likelihood Estimators
problem:
The table below summarizes the maximum likelihood estimates for several common probability distributions. These results can be derived by maximizing the corresponding log-likelihood function. 

| **Distribution** | **Probability Mass Function, $f(x; \theta)$** | **Parameter, $\theta$** | **Maximum Likelihood Estimate, $\widehat{\,\theta\,}$** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bernoulli | $\displaystyle \theta^x(1-\theta)^{1-x}$ | The probability of success | $\displaystyle \dfrac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^n x_i$ 
 The mean of the sample |
| Binomial | $\displaystyle {N \choose x} \theta^x (1-\theta)^{N-x}$ | The probability of success | $\displaystyle \dfrac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^n x_i$ 
 The mean of the sample |
| Poisson | $\displaystyle \dfrac{\theta^{x} e^{-\theta}}{x!}$ | The rate parameter | $\displaystyle \dfrac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^n x_i$ 
 The mean of the sample |
| Geometric | $\displaystyle (1-\theta)^{x-1} \theta$ | The probability of success | $\displaystyle \bigg( \dfrac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^n x_i \bigg)^{-1}$ 
 The reciprocal of the sample mean |
| Exponential | $\displaystyle \theta e^{-\theta x}$ | The rate parameter | $\displaystyle \bigg( \dfrac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^n x_i \bigg)^{-1}$ 
 The reciprocal of the sample mean |
| Normal | $\displaystyle \dfrac{1}{\theta_2 \sqrt{2\pi}} e^{-\frac{1}{2} \left( \frac{x-\theta_1}{\theta_2} \right)^2}$ | The mean $(\theta_1)$ 

 The standard deviation $(\theta_2)$ | $\displaystyle \widehat{\,\theta\,}_1 = \dfrac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^n x_i$ 
 The mean of the sample 

 $\displaystyle \widehat{\,\theta\,}_2 = \sqrt{\dfrac{1}{n} \sum_{i=1}^n (x_i-\overline{x})^2}$ 
 The standard deviation of the sample |
